customManagers.description: Track annotated image/imageName pins in raw manifests so digest/tag pins can't freeze on a vulnerable build

Track the vendored Kratix distribution image. Upstream ships one image that serves as both the controller-manager and the pipeline adapter, referenced twice in install.yaml (Deployment image + PIPELINE_ADAPTER_IMG); both carry the same digest and must move together, so one matchString covers both. Not comment-annotated because install.yaml is vendored wholesale and in-file comments do not survive a re-vendor. Digests are resolved from canonical Docker Hub, not from the syntasso-community.docker.reo.dev vanity host the manifest pulls through: that host is a third-party 307 redirector to registry-1.docker.io, and letting it decide which digest we trust would put it in a position to hand Renovate an attacker-chosen image. Resolving upstream keeps it a transport only — the digest pin means a substituted image fails the content check rather than running. This keeps the image (the part that carries CVEs) current; the CRDs/RBAC around it still need a periodic re-vendor per the procedure in argocd/applications/kratix.yaml.

Port Ocean integration image pin in the ArgoCD Application helm values, annotated with a `renovate:` datasource/depName comment above the version line (mirrors platform-infra so staging and prod ocean images move together).

Inline `image: repo:tag` pins in Helm templates and raw manifests. The helm-values manager only reads values.yaml, so init containers and sidecars declared directly in templates (busybox, alpine/git, netshoot, the opstree redis images, the postgres db-init clients) were invisible to Renovate and drifted. Deliberately excludes provisioning/webhook.yaml, provisioning/control-db.yaml and kratix/install.yaml, which have their own annotated managers above, and the CI-built allowlist-reconciler image.

CloudNativePG `imageName:` pins in Helm values. CNPG uses imageName rather than the image.repository/image.tag pair the helm-values manager expects, so these were unmanaged; provisioning/control-db.yaml has its own annotated manager and is not matched here.

packageRules.description: Private Artifact Registry images are published by CI and Renovate has no credentials for them. Disabling stops the recurring 'No docker auth found' lookup failures.
LinuxServer images publish a new -lsNNN build every few days. Group them so the *arr stack is one reviewable PR rather than nine.
Element/Matrix components are released together and are version-coupled at runtime.
CloudNativePG: the tag's major IS the PostgreSQL major, so a bump is a cluster migration, not an image update. Hold at 16 until one is done deliberately.
The gitea/matrix db-init Jobs run psql as a client against the CloudNativePG server. They track the server major (PG 16), not the newest client.
Paperless' bundled PostgreSQL: a major needs a dump/restore and a volume-layout change. See docs/runbooks/stateful-image-migrations.md.

Immich's PostgreSQL image must carry the vectorchord/pgvectors pair that the running Immich release ships against; a mismatch can break search indexes. Bump this together with immich-server, following Immich's own compose.
TimescaleDB tracks Tracearr's Helm chart, which pins this exact tag and digest, rather than TimescaleDB's own release cadence.
Meilisearch tracks what Karakeep tests against (currently v1.41.0; we are already ahead at v1.43.1). Upgrades need a one-time --upgrade-db launch and cannot be rolled back.
Karakeep's Chrome image is pinned to an immutable browser build; keep it in step with the karakeep release rather than tracking Chrome.
Redis majors change eviction and persistence defaults; the immich/paperless instances hold real cache state, so review those by hand.

Cluster-infrastructure Helm charts land by hand, minors included. Majors alone were gated when the argocd manager was widened in #996, and two minors then broke things unattended: grafana 8.8.2 -> 8.15.0 added `drop: ALL` to its chown init container and wedged the rollout (#1031), and kyverno 3.9.0 shipped a CRD-migration hook that cannot survive ArgoCD's per-resource hook deletion (#1035). These 21 charts are the cluster itself, so anything above a patch gets a look first. Patches still flow on their own.
